backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining user profiles and per-user logo project storage with access control and sorted retrieval.
feature_evidence.json: Structured feature-to-file mapping documenting implemented app features, components, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON mapping of frontend source files to brief human‑written summaries for reference or tooling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables and light/dark theme system.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry point loading the React app and setting metadata and favicon.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app handling authentication, profile setup, logo generation, previews, export, and project selection.
frontend/src/components/AnimatedLogoPrev: Component rendering the animated logo with play/pause and speed controls using dynamic SVG injection.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Shows a login/logout button tied to Internet Identity with loading and error handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for entering and saving a user's name during initial profile setup.
frontend/src/components/ExportButtons.ts: Component offering SVG and PNG download actions for generated logos via helper utilities.
frontend/src/components/MyLogosPanel.tsx: Displays a list of saved logo projects with loading states and lets users select a project.
frontend/src/components/StaticLogoPrevie: Renders static SVG previews in multiple sizes along with the generated wordmark.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Provides hooks to fetch and save the current user's profile using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication state, login, logout, and identity persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useLogoGeneration.ts: Generates static and animated logo SVGs from descriptions and tracks generation state and errors.
frontend/src/hooks/useLogoProjects.ts: Fetches saved logo projects and provides a mutation to save new ones.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and CSS variables defining theme colors for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/logo/generator.ts: Generates a logo specification from a text description, deriving wordmark, colors, shapes, and style using seeded randomness.
frontend/src/logo/renderAnimatedSvg.ts: Renders an animated SVG logo from a specification by drawing and animating shapes and displaying a wordmark.
frontend/src/logo/renderStaticSvg.ts: Outputs a static SVG logo based on a specification with positioned shapes and a styled wordmark.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/utils/download.ts: Provides functions to download logos as SVG or convert and download them as PNG.
frontend/src/utils/seededRandom.ts: Implements a simple 32-bit hash and deterministic random generator with helpers for numbers and choices.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme, colors, plugins, container settings, and custom animations.
project_state.json: Defines the app’s state, including features for offline logo generation, animation, export, theming, and user project persistence. Also includes pending feature requests and required image assets.
